headline: 13 Scroll-deployed Cash contract addresses and 1 verified Optimism token address catalogued; Optimism Cash deployment addresses not yet documented in official sources.

findings.text: Block explorer name-tag search deferred; Scroll contracts documented in official GitBook with explicit addresses and roles.

Official deployments doc located at https://etherfi.gitbook.io/etherfi/contracts-and-integrations/deployed-contracts. Scroll Cash contract addresses extracted with labelled roles. Optimism Cash contract addresses not yet listed (weETH bridge token is listed as 0x5A7fACB970D094B6C7FF1df0eA68D99E6e73CBFF).
No audit links provided in per-protocol context; GitHub repository README mentions audits by Certora & Nethermind but no URLs to audit reports found in fetched sources.

GitHub repo https://github.com/etherfi-protocol/cash-v3 confirmed; contains /deployments folder referenced in README but tree-view access blocked. Broadcast artifacts likely exist but require direct JSON file fetch or alternate access.

Protocol operates on 2 chains per per-protocol context: Optimism (primary as of Apr 2026 migration completion) and Scroll (original, prior). Cross-chain token addresses extracted from D2 source per chain.
No factory contracts identified in fetched sources for child enumeration; User Safe Factory on Scroll (0x18Fa07dF94b4E9F09844e1128483801B24Fe8a27) noted but enumeration pattern not fetched.

14 addresses catalogued with roles: 11 Scroll Cash modules (settlement, pricing, debt, cashback dispatch, data provider, pre-order, topup), 1 User Safe Factory, 1 User Safe Lens, 1 Optimism weETH bridge token.
All admin_addresses[] entries trace to https://etherfi.gitbook.io/etherfi/contracts-and-integrations/deployed-contracts (fetched index 2) with explicit role labels per GitBook table.

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice: walked official deployed contracts doc (GitBook), GitHub source repo, migration announcements, and news coverage. Catalogued 13 Scroll-deployed Cash contracts with explicit roles + 1 verified Optimism weETH token address. Optimism Cash core contract deployment addresses not yet published in official or fetched sources; recorded as unknown in unknowns[]. No audits, no factories enumerated, no GitHub deployment artifacts directly fetched.

evidence.shows: Official deployed contracts page; Scroll Cash contract addresses with roles: User Safe Lens, Factory, Event Emitter, Swapper, Settlement Dispatcher, Price Provider, Debt Manager, Cashback Dispatcher, Data Provider, Pre-order Contract, TopUp Dest. Cross-chain token addresses including Optimism weETH (0x5A7fACB970D094B6C7FF1df0eA68D99E6e73CBFF) and Scroll weETH (0x01f0a31698c4d065659b9bdc21b3610292a1c506).
EtherFi official announcement of Cash migration to Optimism on Feb 18, 2026; describes partnership to move 70k cards, 300k accounts, $160M TVL from Scroll to OP Mainnet.
Optimism Foundation official blog post (Feb 18, 2026) confirming ether.fi Cash migration partnership and benefits to Optimism ecosystem.
Completed migration report (~early April 2026, ~3 weeks prior to analysis date); migration took 3 days with zero downtime, $220M TVL moved, 70k active cards and 300k accounts now on Optimism.

Source code repository for ether.fi Cash V3 smart contracts; includes /deployments and /broadcast folders referenced for Foundry deployment artifacts; fully audited by Certora & Nethermind per README.

protocol_metadata.about: EtherFi Cash Liquid is a non-custodial crypto card and neobanking product that allows users to spend cryptocurrency in the real world via Visa/Mastercard integration while earning yield on idle balances. The product was launched on Scroll in September 2024 and migrated to Optimism in February–April 2026 as part of a long-term partnership with Optimism to enable seamless on-chain payments and deeper DeFi integration.
